Some U.S. companies are using H-1B visas to staff their DEI offices.

I've reviewed numerous examples of hospitals, universities and other employers hiring foreign H-1B workers as DEI bureaucrats.

I'm urging USCIS to work with us to fix this. 🧵

Documents we reviewed show a range of U.S. employers have sought to hire foreign H-1B workers to fill their DEI positions.

For example, Yale New Haven Health filed Labor Condition Applications (LCA) for H-1B visas for the role of “Diversity and Inclusion Specialist” in 2021: https://t.co/KfCGibAml6

Examples range from large banks and law firms to universities, healthcare systems, and even municipal park districts.

Obviously, DEI positions are plainly non-technical and ideological in nature, and appear to fall outside the “specialty occupation” intent of the H-1B statute.
